decision: Playwright is evidence, not the template
reason: Clicks a handle to a text node, which has no box of its own and no locator: a click on the node's text lands on the element that contains it, and Strider's locators address elements only

decision: Playwright is evidence, not the template
reason: Clicks a handle to a node the page removed, and expects the click to fail as a node that is not attached to the DOM. A Strider locator finds the element again, so a removed element is a missing match, not a detached node; the handle's own binding is what this test needs
With the visible check off, an element with no box reports OutsideViewport instead of NotVisible
On stock WebKit the engine runs in the page's world, so a page that deletes Node, Event, or JSON.stringify, or redefines innerWidth, breaks it
